h1: Custom 14 oz Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 14 oz badges in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events and promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 14 oz badges offer a substantial feel that lighter badges lack, making them ideal for trade shows and corporate events where durability matters. The extra weight gives a premium impression, perfect for security badges or commemorative pins that recipients will keep. Choose from metal or plastic materials, and decorate with full-color printing or debossing for a professional finish that represents your brand well.
heroAltText: Custom 14 oz badges with metal finish and full-color print, displayed on a lanyard for corporate events.
